overview: The Medford Zoning Board of Appeals met to hear multiple residential requests, including administrative appeals regarding state-protected accessory dwelling units (ADUs), dimensional variances, and special permits. The board approved a permit extension for a mixed-use project at 590 Boston Avenue, granted dimensional relief and special permits for proposals on Vassar Street, Wellesley Street, and Albion Street, and approved the reconstruction of a three-family dwelling on South Street.

items.title: 226 Main Street
items.summary: The board granted the applicant's request to continue the hearing for a proposed three-story, three-unit townhouse dwelling to December 3, 2026.

items.title: 590 Boston Avenue
items.summary: The board approved a two-year extension for a variance and special permit for the demolition of a gas station and car wash to construct a five-story mixed-use building with 45 units and commercial space.

items.title: 1-3 Vassar Street
items.summary: The board granted dimensional relief for a reduced 780-square-foot protected accessory dwelling unit and approved a special permit to extend an existing nonconforming side yard setback vertically.

items.title: 12 Wellesley Street
items.summary: The board granted dimensional relief allowing the applicant to construct two shed dormers for a 769-square-foot third-story protected accessory dwelling unit.

items.title: 11 Albion Street
items.summary: The board approved a variance for third-floor square footage and a special permit to extend a side setback nonconformity vertically to expand living space in a single-family home.

items.title: 75 South Street
items.summary: The board approved a special permit to demolish an existing dilapidated three-family home and construct a new three-story, three-unit residential building.
